name: feature-plan-impact-cli
goal: Expose the committed affected pages and blockers for a proposed feature plan before image generation

evidence: The existing coverage validator discovers direct, relationship and hierarchy page impacts, but task plan offers no pre-design command. Expose it without source scans, writes or provider calls.
At 37d50974d4 the read-only plan impact command validates proposal fields, reads committed metadata for the selected source and invokes the existing page-coverage discovery without a provider.

Seven focused command/helper tests passed; at 8a5e2e5de9 a focused TypeScript check and real CLI smoke on harbor-mbp-2 passed. A reuse proposal returned no affected pages; a Work-component modification reported 34 pages and 172 graph blockers with exit 1.
